results.name: SNORLAX
results.tagline: It has taken the hallway and your entire food budget
results.blurb: Your flatmate is enormous, immovable and asleep in the worst possible place. There is no negotiating with it. Meals now happen around its schedule, the fridge is a public facility, and you have started describing its naps to colleagues like weather reports.
results.watchOut: Its comfort has become your problem. Set one boundary about the corridor.

results.name: GENGAR
results.tagline: You are not sure it is living here or haunting here
results.blurb: The lights flicker, the temperature drops in one specific corner and things are not where you left them. It is not hostile. It is funny in a way that is hard to prove. Guests have started asking if your flat is 'like this' and you have stopped explaining.
results.watchOut: You laugh at things that are actually unsettling you. Say it out loud.

results.name: PSYDUCK
results.tagline: It is trying its best and it is doing badly
results.blurb: Your flatmate is anxious, chronically confused and extremely endearing. It follows you from room to room holding its head, it accidentally breaks things with its mind, and it needs a calm explanation about four times an hour. You have never once considered asking it to leave.
results.watchOut: You look after everyone and call it normal. Let someone look after you.

results.name: JIGGLYPUFF
results.tagline: You asked it to stop singing. It did not.
results.blurb: Your flatmate is sweet, round and absolutely convinced of its own talent. There is a microphone. There is a nightly performance nobody requested. It also, genuinely, fixes your mood on the worst days, which is why it still lives here.
strengths: Makes a flat feel like a home
results.watchOut: You give it an audience you don't have the energy for. Close the door sometimes.

results.name: MR. MIME
results.tagline: It has reorganised the flat and it will not discuss it
results.blurb: Every object in your home has been moved to a position it considers correct and cannot explain, because it does not speak. There are invisible walls now. You have walked into three of them. It watches you do this with an expression of enormous patience.
results.watchOut: You let other people arrange your life because it's easier. Move one thing back.

results.name: MAGIKARP
results.tagline: Useless, beloved, and probably going to be incredible
results.blurb: Your flatmate does nothing. It flops. It splashes. It headbutts the door with no effect whatsoever. Everyone who visits asks why you keep it. You cannot explain, and you are quietly certain that one day it will do something astonishing and you will be insufferable about it.
results.watchOut: You're waiting for someone to become worth the effort. Meet them where they are.

results.name: MEOWTH
results.tagline: It pays rent in coins it found somewhere
results.blurb: Your flatmate talks constantly, has an angle on everything and brings home objects of uncertain origin. It is charming, mildly criminal and weirdly good at getting what it wants. You have stopped asking where the money came from, mostly because there is always money.
results.watchOut: You've started accepting shortcuts. Check where the coins come from.
